subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Which linked Teams attachment fix path should be canonical for this issue: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096, or a consolidated follow-up that covers both?
rationale: The remaining choice is not whether the bug exists; it is the fallback policy and config/default shape for Graph message fetches on Teams channel and group-chat HTML stubs.

options.title: Consolidate or sequence both fixes
options.body: Use the channel URL repairs from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 and the default-off group-chat fallback policy from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 so both reported surfaces are covered.

options.title: Land the broader channel fix first
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 for the original channel failure, then decide whether group-chat fallback needs a separate config-gated follow-up.

options.title: Require the config-gated path
options.body: Ask contributors to make the channel fix default-off behind the same graphMediaFallback-style setting before accepting extra Graph lookup behavior.

recommendation.title: Consolidate or sequence both fixes
recommendation.body: Use the channel URL repairs from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 and the default-off group-chat fallback policy from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 so both reported surfaces are covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice involves Teams plugin boundary and config-surface policy, and this history shows broad ownership context for that boundary.
